=== lib/main.dart
import 'package:basic_app/src/counter.dart';

void main() {
  final counter = Counter(2);
  counter.increment();
}
=== lib/src/counter.dart
/// A counter.
class Counter {
  Counter(this.value);

  Counter.zero() : value = 0;

  int value;

  int get doubled => value * 2;

  set doubled(int v) => value = v ~/ 2;

  void increment() {
    // Adds one.
    value++;
  }

  static Counter max(Counter a, Counter b) => a.value > b.value ? a : b;
}

class Display {
  const Display();

  /* Shows the counter. */
  String show(Counter c) => '${c.value}';
}
